headline: Senators from Trump's own party urge him to reverse his Russian diesel deal
headline_short: Senators urge Trump to drop Russian diesel deal
deck: Four Republicans and three Democrats say the deal breaks a 2022 ban on Russian energy imports.
standard: Seven American senators, four Republicans and three Democrats, urged Donald Trump on Sunday to reverse his deal for Russia to deliver just under five million tonnes of diesel to America. Trump announced it on Truth Social, his social media platform, after a call with Vladimir Putin, Russia's president, on Friday.

'Congress expressly banned imports of Russian energy in 2022 to prevent American dollars from financing Putin's brutal war against Ukraine,' the senators wrote. They add that the law required the administration to consult Congress and explain its decision, and it did neither.
The deal comes just under a month before the midterm elections on 3 November.
short: Seven American senators from both parties urged Donald Trump on Sunday to reverse his deal for Russia to deliver just under five million tonnes of diesel, saying it breaks a 2022 law that bans Russian energy imports.
